classification_policy: Each original record is assigned at most one final group. In multi-role posts, an eligible role can be included even if a separate advertised role exceeds 4 years; the entire source post is preserved for traceability. Experience eligibility is based on required lower bound of the selected opening, not upper bound or nice-to-have skills.
dedup_policy: Highly similar/full reposted advertisements (including same application/position), not similar titles alone; original surviving source index retained.
